landing.headline: What do you actually think about AI?
landing.lede: See where you land, find the perspective your answers are closest to, and compare with your friends.

completions.text: {n} people have taken this so far

steps: Answer {n} quick questions. Go with how you lean, or skip any you'd rather not answer.
See where you land on six questions people disagree about, and which perspective your answers are closest to.
Share your result and compare with friends to see where you agree and where you don't.
landing.perspectives_intro: People can look at AI's opportunities and risks in very different ways. Your answers may be closest to one of these perspectives. Or you may fall between them, have your own combination, or still be forming your view.
landing.perspectives_note: These perspectives are conversation starters, not fixed personality types. Your result may be closest to one, between two, your own combination, still forming, or “AI isn't high on your list.”

start.heading: Before you start
paragraphs: By "AI" we mean the tools around today: chatbots and assistants, image and voice tools, recommendation feeds, and software that helps make decisions about people. A few questions ask about more powerful AI in the future, and they'll say so.
There are no right answers. If you're not sure, go with how you lean. You can skip anything.
start.privacy_note: We save an anonymous copy of your answers so we can count results. No name, no email, nothing that identifies you. [Privacy](/privacy)

research_consent.heading: Want to help shape this?
research_consent.body: We're still working out whether these perspectives hold up. If you leave your email, we may get in touch to invite you to a short follow-up, like retaking the quiz in a few weeks or a quick chat about the questions. That's it. No newsletter, no marketing.

research_consent.thanks: Thanks, you're on the list. To be removed, email {contact_email} from the same address.

changelog.heading: What's changed
changelog.intro: Every change to the questions, the perspectives or how results are worked out is listed here, newest first.

entries.what: First version. Six things we ask about, seven perspectives, and three other results (still forming, in between, not a priority).
entries.why: An early AI-drafted plan had ten "tribes". After checking it against published research, we cut it to what the evidence supports.
entries.based_on: a review of 43 published sources and a critical outside review of the questions and perspectives by another AI model (ChatGPT); no quiz answers yet.
entries.past_results: No, this is the first version.
